headline: Star Wars Saga Collection build-a-bar history
post:
Remember when Hasbro tried something totally different for action figure collecting? According to ComicBook.com, the Star Wars Saga Collection featured a unique "build-a-bar" concept in 2002. Fans could assemble a playset replica of the Mos Eisley Cantina's bar spread across six action figures released in two waves of three. 

This clever release included updates to previous figures alongside the debut of Kitik Keed'kak, a massive praying mantis-esque alien. Even though newer playsets have since arrived, diorama-builders still fondly remember this quirky set for its ability to stand in for locations from various films and TV shows.

Did you ever collect any of these classic figures? 🌌✨🧸

#StarWars #ActionFigures #MosEisleyCantina
original_title: This Innovative Star Wars Action Figure Series Took the Build-a-Figure Concept in a Whole New Direction

headline: Mason Thames cast as Dick Grayson
post:
Hey superhero fans! DC Studios has officially cast Mason Thames as the voice of Dick Grayson in the upcoming animated film "Dynamic Duo," according to /Film. 🎬

DC Studios co-head Peter Safran shared that Thames "auditioned the s*** out of it" and was very enthusiastic about joining the DC Universe. Thames will star alongside Logan Kim, who is playing Jason Todd in the movie.

The project uses a unique animation style from Swaybox Studios combining puppetry and CGI. While the film arrives on September 22, 2028, fans are wondering if Thames will also play the character in live-action.

Are you excited for "Dynamic Duo"? 

#MasonThames #DynamicDuo #DCStudios
original_title: DC Studios Officially Casts Mason Thames As Robin — Will He Play Him In Live-Action?
